title: selliguea likiangensis
intro: Selliguea likiangensis, commonly known as the Chinese polypodium, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea likiangensis include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary drivers of its medicinal properties.
